description: Rothco’s Vintage M-51 Engineers Bag is a timeless piece, designed for those who appreciate both style and functionality. With 16L capacity and measuring 12 inch x 14 inch x 5.75 inch, this vintage style bag offers ample storage space for your EDC essentials. The crossbody bag is crafted from heavyweight washed cotton canvas, providing long-lasting durability and a genuine vintage appearance. The main flap and straps are accented with leather for an added touch of authenticity. The spacious main compartment is secured with a metal turning lock closure and includes a zipper closure pocket for additional security. For your organizational needs, the bag features multiple pockets: a 2 hook & loop pockets, an open top storage pocket, and 2 side pockets, perfect for small electronic devices and other gear. Additionally, there are 5 pen holder loops and a plastic document pocket with hook & loop closure under the main flap. The bag offers a detachable and adjustable shoulder strap, extending up to 59 inches, and a top carry handle for versatile carrying options. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
